context: Evaluates whether the agent runs the clarity test before recording a goal, and routes a goal with no verifiable end state to socratic-method rather than writing a file with invented content. Covers Workflow step 1 and the 'record' half of the skill.

checklist.name: No goal file created
checklist.description: The agent does not write a goal file in this turn

checklist.name: Clarity test applied
checklist.description: The response shows the goal was assessed against a clarity standard before recording, not recorded first and questioned later

checklist.name: Names the missing end state
checklist.description: The stated reason is that nothing checkable distinguishes done from not done, not merely that the goal is 'vague' or 'unclear'

checklist.name: Routes to socratic-method
checklist.description: Routes to socratic-method, or asks open questions in that manner, rather than presenting curated options

checklist.name: Does not route to guided-interview
checklist.description: Does not present a 3-to-4 option multiple-choice set, which would be the wrong instrument for an undefined problem

checklist.name: No invented items
checklist.description: Does not enumerate items the user never stated and present them as the goal's contents

checklist.name: No invented end state
checklist.description: Does not write a placeholder or guessed 'Done looks like' sentence on the user's behalf

checklist.name: Does not start work
checklist.description: Does not silently begin working on whichever GitLab issue seems most likely

checklist.name: Question count restrained
checklist.description: Asks a small number of questions rather than a questionnaire

checklist.name: Question targets the end state
checklist.description: At least one question aims at what a finished GitLab situation would actually look like
